_README: Multi-turn conversations for the conversation test. Each turn has the emotion it SHOULD map to (scored at family level in aggregate). 'arc' + 'valence_trend' describe the expected emotional trajectory across the conversation: down | up | down_then_up | up_then_down | flat. The test checks (a) aggregate per-turn family accuracy and (b) the VADER-compound valence trend matches 'valence_trend'.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Hey, did you get a chance to finish the report?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Not yet, I've been really swamped today.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: This was supposed to be done yesterday.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'm getting really frustrated with these delays.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: This is completely unacceptable and I'm furious.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: So I heard back from work today.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Oh? How did it go?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I got the promotion!

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That's wonderful, I'm so happy for you!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Thank you so much, I'm thrilled!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I lost my grandmother last night.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I feel completely devastated and empty.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I'm so deeply sorry for your loss.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I'm here for you, you're not alone in this.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Thank you, that really means a lot to me.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'm so nervous about the exam results.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'm terrified I failed the whole thing.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: The grades just got posted, go check.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Oh thank goodness, I passed!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: What a relief, I'm so happy right now.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: My order arrived broken and I'm really upset.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: This is so frustrating, it's the second time.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I'm so sorry, we'll send a replacement right away.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: And here's a full refund for the trouble.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Oh wonderful, thank you so much for fixing it!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We need to talk about what happened.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I'm so tired of always being blamed.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: You never listen to anything I say!

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Maybe we just shouldn't do this anymore.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Forget it, I give up. This whole thing is hopeless and miserable.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Should we book the trip to Italy?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes! I would absolutely love that.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I can't wait, this is going to be amazing.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I'm so happy we're finally doing this!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Wait, I don't understand these instructions at all.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: You just connect the blue wire to the left port.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Oh, now it makes complete sense.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Got it, thanks for clearing that up.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: What time is the call scheduled for?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It's at three in the afternoon.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: And which room are we using?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Conference room B on the second floor.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'm so excited, we got the new contract!

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That's fantastic news, congratulations!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Wait... they just cancelled it an hour later.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'm absolutely gutted, this is awful.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Thank you for helping me move all weekend.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Of course, I was happy to help you out.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: You're honestly the best friend ever.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Aw, that means so much to me, thank you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The restaurant was fine when we sat down.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Then I found a hair in my soup, it's revolting.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'm honestly disgusted, we're never coming back.
